title: Synthetic remote-access and outbound-transfer review
source_label: Training scenario — sanitized access telemetry summary
narrative: A synthetic remote service sign-in review identified a documentation-range IPv4 address followed by a simulated outbound upload theme. The report requires authorized remote-access and proxy telemetry validation; it does not establish compromise or attribution.

evidence.summary: Synthetic access telemetry records a remote service sign-in from a reserved documentation address.
Synthetic proxy summary references an outbound upload theme and requires analyst validation.
Training scenario specifies that any validation is limited to approved access and proxy telemetry.
